summary: Iteration 79 - CamScanner videoReady state verification. ALL 9 TESTS PASS. Key changes validated: videoReady state, onloadedmetadata handler, capture button disabled until ready. Pure JS ScannerEngine continues to work flawlessly with <10ms operations.

TEST_1_FILE_UPLOAD.details: Upload test image via scanner-file-btn, preview shows immediately with preview-image visible. Console: SCAN START / SCAN DONE 6 ms. All buttons enabled (no opacity-30/40).

TEST_2_FILTERS.details: B&W filter (bg-emerald-500 highlight), Original filter (bg-emerald-500), Contraste+ filter (bg-emerald-500). Console: FILTER START/DONE <2ms for each.

TEST_3_ROTATION.details: Rotate left (ROTATE START: left / ROTATE DONE 1 ms), Rotate right (ROTATE START: right / ROTATE DONE 1 ms). Both operations work correctly.

TEST_4_CROP.details: Click Recadrer -> corner-adjuster visible with manual-mode-badge 'Deplacez les coins', click Appliquer -> CROP START / CROP DONE 0 ms. Crop applied successfully.

TEST_5_ADJUST.details: Click Reglages -> adjust-panel opens with brightness-slider and contrast-slider. Reset button hidden when sliders at default (correct behavior).

TEST_6_MULTI_PAGE.details: Upload first image -> page-counter shows '1' -> click 'Page suivante' (via evaluate) -> camera phase -> upload second image -> preview-finish-btn shows 'Terminer (2 pages)'.

TEST_7_SAVE.details: Click Valider on single page -> finalizing phase triggered -> scanner closes (save completed).

TEST_8_NO_CANVAS_ERRORS.details: ZERO 'getImageData: source width is 0' or canvas errors in console. Guards in scannerEngine.js line 25-28 working correctly.

TEST_9_CLOSE.details: Click scanner-close -> scanner closes successfully, document-scanner element no longer visible.

CAMERA_VIDEOREADY_TEST.details: CRITICAL: Capture button has opacity-40 class when videoReady=false (camera not ready). Button disabled correctly until video dimensions available via onloadedmetadata.
